claims.claim: Existing module src/payments/application/__init__.py exports application handlers.
Payment authorization checks idempotency lock before invoking gateway adapter.
Redis lock instance is stateless per request key and does not leak mutable state across requests.
All callers of authorize_payment pass AuthorizePaymentCommand with idempotency_key.

red_team_findings.description: Reusing idempotency_key with a modified amount_cents could bypass authorization if payload hash is not checked.
red_team_findings.resolution: Added payload_hash SHA-256 verification in WBS 1.1 and WBS 3.1 before returning cached response.

red_team_findings.description: Assumed Redis lock never expires mid-transaction; slow upstream gateway could exceed TTL.
red_team_findings.resolution: Enforced PostgreSQL unique constraint on idempotency_key as secondary guard in WBS 3.1.

decision_deltas.before: Idempotency checked only by idempotency_key lookup.
decision_deltas.after: Idempotency checked by both idempotency_key and SHA-256 payload_hash across WBS 1.1 and WBS 3.1.
